name: backlog-loop
description: Brings a repository up to the backlog-loop template, and later up to date with it. The template's files land in the repo, where you review and commit them; the plugin itself adds no hooks, agents, or loop command.

install.description: Sync the backlog-loop template into this repo, run its setup.sh --fix, and report what is left to do

update.description: Re-sync this repo from the installed template and show the diff for review; never commits
